 PH Navy deploys majority of NDC ships to secure ASEAN Summit
 by 
 Priam Nepomuceno
 Nov 13, 2026
 7:29 PM GMT+8
 Hukbong Dagat ng Pilipinas
 MANILA – The majority of the ships assigned to the Naval Defense Command (NDC) will be deployed to secure the ASEAN Summit and Related Summits from Nov. 16 to 18, according to the Philippine Navy (PN).
"The majority of the vessels under the NDC  will be deployed to provide maritime security and safeguard Manila Bay, its maritime approaches, and other strategically significant maritime areas during the ASEAN Summit," Navy spokesperson Captain Marissa Martinez said in a message to reporters on Friday.
The NDC, which is based in Sangley Point, Cavite City, is formerly known as the Fleet Marine Ready Force.
Martinez declined to elaborate but said two of the Navy's brand-new offshore patrol vessels - - the 2,400 ton BRP Rajah Sulayman (PS-20) and BRP Rajah Lakandula (PS-21) - - will be among the ships tasked with this duty.
Earlier, PN public affairs office chief Captain Marie Angelica DC Sisican said the Navy will be deploying "key sea assets" in Manila Bay as part of its security efforts for the ASEAN meet. 
Through these efforts, the PN reinforces the government's overall security preparations, helping ensure a safe and secure maritime environment for the successful conduct of the engagements, she said. 
Major activities for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits will be held at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City. (PNA)
